metadata.title: Ethereal Monochromatic Portrait with Calligraphic Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, monochromatic portrait of a face partially obscured by a hand, rendered in soft, grainy greyscale tones that fade into a neutral background, topped with a vibrant, intricate calligraphic script featuring extreme swashes.
coreVisualRelationships: The hand acts as a frame for the eyes, creating a layered depth.
The sharp, dark purple typography contrasts against the soft, diffused greyscale image.
The circular swashes of the text echo the rounded forms of the facial features and fingers.
coreInvariants: High-key lighting with minimal shadow detail
Fine-grain texture throughout the photographic element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face is centered but slightly low, with a hand positioned horizontally across the forehead and upper eyes.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes, rendered with the most contrast, serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the dark text at the top, follows the swashes down to the hand, and settles on the gaze of the subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive light grey negative space on the right side and bottom, creating a sense of airiness.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Light grey/off-white background and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Mid-tone greys for facial features and hand definition.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep plum or violet for the typographic elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value (brightness), punctuated by a single high-contrast, saturated hue for the text.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes
Elongated, circular swashes that loop back over the letters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature oversized, spiraling flourishes that extend horizontally across the composition.

composition.overlap: Overlays the top of the hand

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative script against a minimalist photographic background.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary formal elegance and swash potential.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key, monochromatic greyscale portrait of a person's face. A hand is placed horizontally across the forehead, partially obscuring the top of the eyes. The lighting is very soft, creating a dreamy, ethereal effect with visible film grain. The background is a flat, light grey that blends with the skin tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of custom calligraphic script in a deep plum color at the top center. The script should feature extreme, circular swashes that loop and overlap the letters, resembling 1970s soul album typography.

verificationChecks: Is the image high-key with minimal dark shadows?
Does the text feature large, looping flourishes?
Is the color palette restricted to greyscale and one accent color?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the flourishes.
Check that the grain texture is uniform across the image.
Verify the high-key exposure doesn't blow out all facial details.
Confirm the purple accent is the only non-grey color.
recipe.reuseFormula: Soft-focus monochromatic portrait + high-key lighting + centered hand gesture + oversized calligraphic script with circular swashes in a single jewel-tone accent.
